tagline.en_US: VS Code is an integrated development environment developed by Microsoft. This container runs the full desktop application, for a web native version see Code Server.

description.en_US: VS Code is an integrated development environment developed by Microsoft. It provides tools for code editing, debugging, and software development within a desktop environment accessible via a web browser. It is useful for managing programming projects and writing code across multiple languages.

tips: Copy and paste between your computer and the streamed desktop, including images, works over HTTPS: port 3001 or an HTTPS reverse proxy. Browsers block clipboard access over plain HTTP.
